title: Add Reflexion loop to orchestrator agent
description:
## Summary

Implement SOTA Reflexion pattern in the orchestrator agent to enable iterative self-critique and revision of worker outputs.

## Background

Research on state-of-the-art multi-agent orchestration patterns (Jan 2026) identified that our orchestrator is missing critical capabilities:

1. **Reflexion Loop** - Self-critique → revise → iterate cycle for task outputs
2. **Bidirectional Reflection Protocol (BRP)** - Monitor agent watching orchestrator decisions
3. **Structured State Management** - Explicit state schema for agent coordination

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Orchestrator implements reflexion loop after worker task completion
- [ ] Quality acceptance criteria defined (tests pass, coverage, linter)
- [ ] Max iteration limit to prevent infinite loops (suggest 3)
- [ ] Metrics captured for reflexion effectiveness

## References

- AWS Strands Agents (Reflexion): https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/customize-agent-workflows-with-advanced-orchestration-techniques-using-strands-agents/
- COCO Framework (BRP): https://arxiv.org/html/2508.13815
- Agent-R (Self-Training): https://arxiv.org/html/2501.11425v3
- LangGraph Multi-Agent Patterns: https://blog.langchain.com/langgraph-multi-agent-workflows

## Related

- OpenSpec proposal: enhance-orchestrator-reflection (to be created)
close_reason: Implemented SOTA reflexion capabilities per OpenSpec proposal
